description:
About our brand and products:

Chazoku is a U.S.-based matcha brand focused on premium Japanese matcha, clean flavor, and an elevated daily ritual. Our matcha is carefully selected for smooth taste, vibrant color, and a clean finish that works beautifully in lattes, iced matcha, recipes, and everyday wellness routines.


What makes us different:

We focus on quality, freshness, and customer experience. Chazoku matcha is known for being smooth, creamy, and easy to enjoy without the harsh bitterness many people expect from matcha. We also have strong social proof across TikTok Shop, Amazon, and our online store, with customers loving the taste, packaging, and overall experience.


How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn commission by promoting Chazoku products through their unique affiliate link or code. Every qualifying sale generated through your link can earn you commission. This is a great fit for creators in matcha, wellness, lifestyle, recipes, beauty, health, fitness, and aesthetic drink content.


How to promote us:

You can promote Chazoku through TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, recipe videos, unboxing content, morning routines, matcha latte tutorials, honest reviews, wellness content, and comparison videos. Strong content ideas include “how I make my daily matcha,” “matcha latte recipe,” “coffee alternative,” “aesthetic drink routine,” and “why I switched to matcha.”


Other information:

We love working with creators who genuinely enjoy matcha and can create warm, authentic, high-quality content. Our best-performing content usually feels natural, educational, aesthetic, and personal. We encourage affiliates to show the product clearly, explain the taste, demonstrate how to prepare it, and include a clear call-to-action for viewers to shop through your link.
